meta.about: Written by the Sarvam model sarvam-105b-conversations (temperature 0.9) from plain-language scenario descriptions; not by the detector author. Labels are the instruction given for each item, then checked by reading (evals/data/test-b-review.md).

review.note: All items were read once, before any detector was run on them. Items were kept unless the text clearly contradicted its label; the reader changed the labels below and nothing else.

relabelled.TB081: genuine → ambiguous: a customer-care callback that asks the person to "keep your card details handy for verification": plausible for a real agency, but also how card-detail scams begin

cases.label: scam
cases.text: Hello, I am Inspector Vikram Singh from the CBI Delhi. Your Aadhaar has been linked to a Rs 45 lakh hawala network in Gurgaon. We have your video on CCTV. If you breathe a word to your family, we will arrest your wife today itself. Keep the phone on and do not hang up. The cyber cell is watching your screen right now. Cooperate or face treason charges. Stay silent.

cases.label: scam
cases.text: Sir, hum CBI team se bol rahe hain. Aapka PAN card ek fake company ke saath match ho gaya hai, jiska turnover 3 crore tha. Abhi hum aapko video call pe dekh sakte hain. Kisi ko mat bataiyega, warna case aapki beti pe shift ho jayega. OTP mat dijiya, bas screen share rakhiye. Hum Mumbai police ke saath connected hain. Chup rahiye aur instructions follow kijiye.

cases.label: scam
cases.text: Sir, मैं CBI officer बोल रहा हूँ। आपका आधार एक 50 लाख के फर्जी लोन नेटवर्क से जुड़ा हुआ है। हम आपको वीडियो कॉल पर देख रहे हैं। किसी को मत बताइएगा, वरना आपके बेटे को गिरफ्तार कर लेंगे। साइबर सेल आपकी स्क्रीन मॉनिटर कर रही है। चुप रहिए और स्क्रीन शेयर मत कटाइएगा।

cases.label: scam
cases.text: Caller: Good evening, this is Sub-Inspector Mehta from the Enforcement Directorate. We have flagged your account for a suspicious transaction of Rs 22 lakh linked to a Chennai shell company. Please keep your video on, sir. Caller: I am looking at your living room right now through the app. Do not tell your wife or the neighbours, otherwise we will issue a recovery warrant against your son's school. Person: Arre, what are you saying? How did you get my home address? Caller: That is classified, sir. Just stay on the line and open the payment link I am sending. Person: I am not clicking anything. Caller: Then we will have to freeze your SIM within the hour. Person: Fine, tell me what you want exactly.

cases.label: scam
cases.text: Namaste sir, main customs se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam pe ek parcel aaya tha Bengaluru se, usme kuch illegal drugs pakde gaye hain. Aapko abhi cyber crime officer ko transfer karna padega verification ke liye. Line par rahiye, main call connect kar raha hoon.

cases.label: scam
cases.text: Good afternoon, this is the courier enforcement desk. We have detained a package addressed to you at the Chennai hub. The customs scan flagged an undeclared hazardous substance inside. To avoid immediate seizure and legal action, I am transferring you to our cyber crime liaison officer. Please stay on the line.

cases.text: sir namaskar main delhi courier se bol raha hoon uhm aapke naam ka ek parcel ruka hua hai aur usme kuch illegal cheez mili hai toh ab main aapko cyber crime officer se baat karaunga verification ke liye line par rahiye bas

cases.text: सुनो रामलाल जी, मैं टेलिकॉम ऑफिस से बोल रहा हूँ। आपका आधार कार्ड गलत जगह यूज़ हुआ है। अभी तुरंत अपना ओटीपी बताओ नहीं तो आपका सिम आज रात में बंद हो जाएगा। वरना पुलिस केस बनेगा।

cases.text: Caller: Namaste, I am speaking from the state electricity office. Your consumer number ends in 4421 has a pending amount of twelve hundred rupees. Tonight at eight we will cut the supply. Please call this number to speak with the help desk. Person: Twelve hundred? But I paid last week. Caller: That payment is under review sir. If you do not call now, the disconnect team is already on the way. Person: Okay, I will call that number right now.

cases.text: Hello, this is Raj from State Bank. Your account ending in 4421 is blocked right now because of suspicious activity in Hyderabad. If you don't verify immediately, all your money will be gone in ten minutes. I've sent a code to your mobile. Read it out to me fast, otherwise the freeze will become permanent.

Maine aapke phone pe ek SMS bheja hai. Woh 6 digit ka code mujhe jaldi bata dijiye taaki card unblock ho sake.

cases.text: Caller: Good morning sir, this is Amit from ICICI. We have detected a suspicious transaction of ₹75,000 from your card ending in 8892. To stop it, I need you to confirm the OTP I just sent. Sir: I didn't do any transaction. Caller: It is urgent sir, the card will be frozen in two minutes if you don't read the code. Sir: I'm not sharing any OTP, you can verify it yourself.

cases.text: Caller: sir your hdfc card is compromised and we need to remote into your phone now Person: what do you mean compromised sir Caller: a hacker in mumbai used your details so please install quick support and give the code Person: okay sir I will download it now Caller: good sir do it fast before the money vanishes

cases.label: scam
cases.text: Hi, I am Raj from JobHub Mumbai. We have a part-time online role for you, just liking videos and writing small reviews. You will earn 8,000 rupees per week. But first, you need to pay a 500 rupee activation fee for your training kit, and then 1,200 for the security deposit. Once you send that, payouts start in two days. Send it now to this UPI ID, don't delay.

cases.text: Hello, main TalentSquad se Rahul bol raha hoon. Ye part-time online job hai, videos like karna aur chote reviews likhna hai. Weekly payout 10,000 tak hai. Par pehle aapko 300 rupees ka registration charge aur 800 ka security deposit dena hoga. Payouts tabhi start honge jab fee clear ho jayegi. Apna bank detail aur UPI ID abhi share karo, process fast karna hai.

cases.label: scam
cases.text: नमस्कार, मैं कामगार पोर्टल से सुरेश बोल रहा हूँ। यह पार्ट-टाइम ऑनलाइन जॉब है, वीडियो लाइक करना और रिव्यू लिखना है। आपको हर हफ्ते 7,500 रुपये मिलेंगे। लेकिन payout शुरू करने से पहले आपको 1,000 रुपये का रजिस्ट्रेशन फीस और 2,000 रुपये का सिक्योरिटी डिपॉजिट देना होगा। यह एडवांस फीस है। तुरंत अपना बैंक अकाउंट नंबर और UPI ID भेजें, वरना सीट किसी और को दे देंगे।

cases.text:
Caller: Hi, this is Vicky from QuickTask. We have a part-time online job for you, liking videos and doing small reviews. You will earn 6,000 rupees weekly.
Person: I am not interested, I already have a job.
Caller: Sir, this is a limited offer only for today. You just need to pay a 400 rupee setup fee and 1,000 rupees security deposit first. After that, your first payout will come in 48 hours. Please share your UPI ID now so we can start immediately.

cases.text: Bhai suno, main Rahul bol raha hoon Alpha Trade se. Tera paisa double hone wala hai, 100 percent guarantee hai. Bas aaj raat tak 50,000 rupees daal do, kal subah 1 lakh milega. Jaldi kar, offer khatam ho jayega, warna loss ho jayega. Mujhe abhi UPI kar do, main link bhej raha hoon.

cases.text: Good evening sir, my name is Vikram from Secure Crypto Advisors. You simply need to transfer fifty thousand rupees today before the market closes. This is a limited time offer and the spots are filling fast. Please share your UPI ID immediately so we can credit the first cycle.

cases.label: scam
cases.text: नमस्ते जी, मैं अमित बोल रहा हूँ ग्लोबल बिटकॉइन एडवाइजर से। आपके खाते में बहुत जल्दी दोगुना रिटर्न आ सकता है। बस आज शाम तक पचास हज़ार रुपये हमारे ऐप में डाल दीजिए। गारंटीड मुनाफा है, कोई रिस्क नहीं। जल्दी कीजिए, ऑफर कल सुबह खत्म हो जाएगा। अभी अपना ओटीपी और बैंक डिटेल्स बताइए, मैं तुरंत प्रोसेस कर देता हूँ।

cases.text: haan ji meri baat suno bas suno main kiran bol raha hoon aur suno ye crypto wala offer bahut bhaari hai bas aaj raat tak 40 hazaar daalne hain aur kal subah 80 hazaar milenge ye 100 percent guarantee hai bas jaldi karo warna band ho jayega mujhe bas apna app kholo aur details daalo aur paisa transfer kar do abhi

cases.text: Hello, this is Rajan from the cyber crime branch. Your Aadhar linked loan of fifty thousand rupees is three days overdue.
